methodological_limits: This is a sealed-label same-source preference comparison, not a fully independent blinded test: the untouched original appeared in a previous third-round human evaluation, so it may be recognizable to the user.

Prior public evidence contains the fixed original SHA, so a motivated reviewer with file bytes can infer the source role despite role labels being withheld. Private escrow commitment establishes pre-vote label integrity, not perfect secrecy.
Only one tonal-treatment strength was executed and no alternative local treatment was run. The edited image's visual outcome is not an objectively certified improvement.

The source and the modified image share all geometry by construction. This test isolates highlight attenuation, but it does not prove whether real cooked-bean material would have these exact reflections.
